# Aryan (@aryanonai) — AI Developer, Builder, and ISTMX Creator

Aryan, publicly known as aryanonai, is a developer and student based in India. He uses `istmX` as his developer handle and GitHub identity. He builds AI agents, full-stack software, and ISTMX, a source-first collection of editable React components. This website is Aryan’s canonical portfolio and the first-party documentation source for ISTMX. The component source repository is [GitHub](https://github.com/istmX/final_portfolio_repo).

## Main pages

- [Portfolio](https://aryanonai.vercel.app/): Profile, technical focus, projects, and contact links.
- [ISTMX Component Library](https://aryanonai.vercel.app/library): Source-first React components with previews, install commands, usage examples, and API references.
- [Writing](https://aryanonai.vercel.app/blogs): Articles by Aryan about AI agents, software engineering, and developer workflows.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/istmX): Open-source projects and code.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aryan-xf/): Professional profile.
- [X](https://x.com/Istm_x): Social profile.

## Selected projects

- [Crew](https://aryanonai.vercel.app/#projects): An autonomous AI workforce project.
- [CodeCat](https://aryanonai.vercel.app/#projects): An AI code review tool.
- [Noiseless](https://aryanonai.vercel.app/#projects): An AI research workflow project.
- [ISTMX Skills](https://istmx.dpdns.org/): Developer skills and tooling, with source at [GitHub](https://github.com/istmX/skills).

## ISTMX components

Each component page is the canonical documentation page for its editable source. The components are copied into a consuming project; the CLI does not require a hosted runtime.

- [Animated Text](https://aryanonai.vercel.app/library/animated-text): rotating text with configurable blur, fade, shimmer, slide, and character-wave effects.
- [Image Accordion](https://aryanonai.vercel.app/library/image-accordion): a selectable image stack that transitions the selected image into a preview canvas.
- [Dock Navigation](https://aryanonai.vercel.app/library/dock-navigation): an icon dock with pointer-proximity scaling, elastic lift, and moving tooltips.
- [Mobile Menu Dock](https://aryanonai.vercel.app/library/mobile-menu-dock): a mobile navigation menu with local component search and caller-provided links.
- [Scroll Story Cards](https://aryanonai.vercel.app/library/scroll-story-cards): a continuous scroll-driven sequence of cards following a curved path.
- [Pixel Cat](https://aryanonai.vercel.app/library/pixel-cat): a pixel-art cat that moves within a measured parent container and supports optional interaction.

Aryan is the creator of ISTMX. The portfolio connects the Aryan / aryanonai identity to the ISTMX library, projects, public profiles, and articles through first-party pages and source links.

For crawlable public pages, see the [sitemap](https://aryanonai.vercel.app/sitemap.xml). The development playground and Cat Home experience are not intended for search indexing.
